Ferwater (formerly Ferwater Island)

Ferwater

  • Stats
  • Info

Region

Ferwater

Purpose

To chop more expensive wood, rocks and access new areas

Date Added

?

Music

Kevin MacLeod - Desert City (Desert, old)

Ferwater, formerly known as Ferwater Island, is a remote area accessed via a bridge from Finlay. While some common materials like Oak and Birch appear here, Ferwater contains more different types of trees, rocks, and ores compared to Finlay. In general, the material on Ferwater may be considered more valuable than the default materials offered on the surface of Finlay. Scorpions and frogs can also be found here and be caught for money.

Notable Locations

Ferwater is split into several biomes, the main ones being:

  • Ferwater Savanna, the lush grasslands of the island
  • Ferwater Desertlands, also known as Oke Desert
  • Desert Badlands, which is home to worms, scorpions, and harsh terrain
  • Desert River
  • Frozen Desert
  • Desert Oasis
  • Classic Biome/Archipelago
  • Desert Rift, which has an elevator you can go to the ground
  • Desert Mines, where scorpions and skeletons can spawn
  • Boomite Cave
  • Mushroom Cave, also known as Uncertainty Cave

Ferwater is its own island, unlike in previous updates where it was connected to Finlay. Now, the bridge is the only way you can get to Ferwater.

Stores

Ferwater has four unique stores, but they are quite far apart:

  • Illumine Designs
  • Fungi Finds
  • Pirate Boat Shop
  • Dugg’s Digging

As the most prominent shop, Illumine Designs is located towards the back end of the Oke Desert. This store offers a wider selection of doors, decoration items, water blocks, elevators, and more advanced schematics.

Fungi Finds is a secret shop located in Uncertainty Cave hidden behind a wall that can be broken with explosives, offering quality-of-life and decoration items.

The Pirate Boat shop is a moving store that offers high-tier explosives, useful for breaking walls to access other areas in the map. It can be located at several points in Ferwater:

  • Directly to the left of the bridge entrance, on the normal sand beach.
  • On the northernmost past of the red sand beach, on the wooden plank bridge.
  • At the deepest point of Uncertainty Cave, next to the breakable wall for Fungi Finds.

Dugg's Digging is the newest shop in Ferwater, located high in the Desert Highlands. It's accessible by driving to the rift and taking the path on the right. You'll enter a valley where the shop can be seen. This shop offers the highest-tier explosives, the Boom Blaster, and other mining themed items.

Quests and Secrets

Ferwater has several notable locations and hidden secrets. There are many breakable walls in this area of the map, so be sure to have a bomb or two to access these areas. The Pirate Boat shop offers high-tier explosive supplies to break down these walls much quicker. The most notable locations related to quests are listed here:

Skull Rock

Skull Rock is a secret quest location hidden at the top of a lone rock plateau. Inside of Skull Rock is a secret quest item called the Skull, one of the three components for the Emberbane Axe quest. The Skull is hidden behind an unmarked breakable floor, which takes at least three low-tier explosives to break. The Skull can then be brought to the Magma Caves in Mike's Mines to turn it into the Burning Skull.

Desertlands Pedestal

The Desertlands or Oke Desert Pedestal, is used for completing the special quests for the Uncertain Pickaxe and the Adurite Key, is located at the northern side of the savanna.

Mysterious Mushroom Spore Infusion

Uncertainty Cave is a special mining area, also known as the Mushroom Cave. There are several access points from the Desert Mines and the canyon in the center of the desert. The easiest way to access this area is by driving into the canyon and searching for one of its entrances. The easiest and closest exit point is by using the Desert Mines entrance in the plateau near Illumine Designs. It contains the secret Fungi Finds shop and a potential location for the Pirate Boat shop. Players can farm Mysterious Mushrooms at this location.

In relation to quests and secrets, mushroom spore projectiles from Mysterious Mushrooms can be used to enchant, infuse, and corrupt certain items. The following list describes these unique quest items, using spore projectile you can infuse:

  • Refined or forged Inkstone into ? ? ?, for the Uncertain Pickaxe quest.
  • A Meteor Core into a Corrupted Meteor Core, for the Fusion Coil quest.

Classic Biome/Archipelago Access

The Classic Archipelago is an area where you can harvest retro materials (which used to spawn on Finlay during anniversary events but have since been made permanent additions to Oaklands). You can find more detailed info on these resources on the Classic Biome page. The following materials are found here:

  • Classic Trees, common rarity, early-game tree, spawn on grass stud textures in the Classic Biome.
  • Classic Cactus, common rarity, early-game tree, spawn on sand stud textures in the Classic Biome.
  • Classic Purple Cactus, common rarity, early/mid-game tree, spawn on sand stud textures in the Classic Biome.
  • Classic Stone, common rarity, early-game ore, spawn throughout the Classic Biome.
  • Oreable, common rarity, early-game ore, spawn on Classic Stone nodes throughout the Classic Biome.
  • Bombastic, uncommon rarity, mid-game ore, spawn uncommonly on Classic Stone nodes throughout the Classic Biome, spawn with high frequency near the Classic Store.
  • Classic Sand, common rarity, early-game ore, spawn on sand stud textures in the Classic Biome.

In relation to secret quests, the Classic Store located here is important for the Fusion Coil quest, where you can buy a Speed Coil, Healing Coil, and Gravity Coil depending on the rotating stock of this store. All of these coils except the Fusion Coil can be obtained via Daily Rewards as well.

Crown Monuments

There are several Crown Monuments scattered across Ferwater, with different associated Element Symbols (for example, a symbol for fire, a snowflake, wind, acid, and a black broken heart). These monuments also wear a crown that emulates the element, with the same color. There is an in-game topographical map in the Desert Mines that shows all the locations of the monuments, with differently colored particle effects. Most notably, there appears to be a main monument located at the very top of the Desert Oasis that can be reached with Freecam.

Most of the monuments are covered with sand, like the Great Pyramid in the back of the Desertlands, suggesting that this quest is a Work-in-Progress. No known function is associated with these monuments at this time.

Lumberwork

Crossover Trees

Several tree species are found elsewhere more commonly. For example, Oak trees can spawn in Ferwater, but they spawn in much larger groups and with greater frequency in Finlay. To hopefully avoid confusion, these seemingly universal resources (for example, Oak trees, which would not be the first tree you think of when searching for info on Ferwater) are separated. This list contains trees that are more commonly found in Finlay and other areas, but can also be found in Ferwater:

  • Oak, common rarity, early-game tree, spawns near the bridge entrance to Ferwater from Finlay and surrounding the Desert Highlands Rivers, most common in Finlay.
  • Birch, common rarity, early-game tree, spawns near the bridge entrance to Ferwater from Finlay and surrounding the Desert Highlands Rivers, most common in Finlay.
  • Willow, common rarity, early-game tree, spawns near the Desert Highlands Rivers, most common in Flowering Meadows and the Acidlands.
  • Palm Trees, common rarity, early-game tree, spawns sparsely on the surface of Oke Desert, spawns most frequently on beaches.
  • King Palm, common rarity, early-game tree, tree variant, spawns in the Desert Highlands Oasis, spawns most frequently on beaches.
  • Kelp, common rarity, spawns underwater in Ook Lake and on beaches, profitable early and mid game but is not truly viable without a Refined Scooba Tank (mid/late game quest item). Useful for making grass textures in schematics.
  • Bamboo, common rarity, spawns near inland water sources, including Ook Lake and the Desert Highlands Oasis, also spawns in forests in the Ferwater Savannah across of Ook Lake.

Trees in Ferwater Savannah

Unique tree species spawn on Ferwater. Due to the presence of multiple biomes in Ferwater, the tree species differ by which part of the map you are located in. The Ferwater Savannah offers four unique tree types:

  • Wanwood Trees, common rarity, mid-game tree, spawns across Ook Lake in Ferwater Savannah. Not profitable, largely used for building and filling schematics with green wood textures.
  • Redwood Trees, common rarity, mid-game tree, spawns across Ook Lake in Ferwater Savannah. Not profitable, largely used for building and filling schematics with red wood textures.
  • Acacia Trees, common rarity, early-game tree, in Ferwater Savannah and Oke Desert, offers different fruits depending on the spawning location. Not profitable, largely used for the fruits it produces to make jams and filling schematics with orange wood.
  • Ferwater Clover, uncommon rarity, early-game tree, relative uncommon spawn in Ferwater Savannah. Despite being rarer, it is less profitable than other trees in this location.

Trees in Ferwater Desert (Oke Desert)

The Ferwater Desert (also known as Oke Desert), located behind the Savannah area, contains multiple tree/wood types, most being desert themed:

  • Acacia Trees, common rarity, early-game tree, sparsely compared to the Savannah region.
  • Deadwood, common rarity, early-game tree, spawns sparsely on the surface of Oke Desert, spawns in clusters in the Canyon. Despite its high sell-value at over $40/stud, it is not profitable due to its small overall size (like bamboo). Used for filling schematics with darker wood textures and enhance the desert biome overall.
  • Cactus, common rarity, early-game tree, spawns frequently on sand in Oke Desert and the Desert Highlands. Profitable early-game but there are much better options as you progress.
  • Purple Cactus, uncommon rarity, mid-game tree, spawns sparsely on the surface of Oke Desert, spawns frequently on plateaus. Profitable early to mid-game but there are much better options as you progress, especially due to its inconvenient spawn location.
  • Frisply Clover, uncommon rarity, early-game tree, relatively uncommon spawn on Oke Desert sand. Despite being rarer, it is less profitable than other trees in this location.

Trees in Desert Mines and Uncertainty Cave

The Desert is connected with a very expansive cave system called the Desert Mines. It can be accessed by many entrances across the Desert, as well as simply falling into the Canyon at the center of the area. The following denotes the tree types that spawn in these underground areas:

  • Bone Trees, common rarity, scattered in the Desert Mines and Canyon areas of Oke Desert, not profitable but useful for filling schematics which white wood.

Uncertainty Cave offers multiple types of Mushrooms as well as Mysterious Mushrooms:

  • Mushrooms (Red, Blue, Green, Purple), common rarity, early/mid-game tree, spawn on the floor of the Mushroom Cave/Uncertainty Cave. Profitable early/mid-game, but there are better options. However, comes in several color variants, making it useful for simulating colored sand and grass textures.
  • Mysterious Mushrooms, uncommon rarity, mid/late-game tree, only spawns on the ceiling of Uncertainty Cave. Extremely profitable - caps sell for ~$2500 each, and the wood sells for over $100/stud sanded or planked.
  • Oobmab, uncommon rarity, mid/late-game tree, spawns in Oobmab Lake hidden behind an explodable wall in Uncertainty Cave. Higher sell value than regular Bamboo but lower that Mysterious Mushrooms makes this tree less viable to farm for profit (not to mention its smaller size). Largely for filling schematics that use a purple color scheme.

Trees in Desert Highlands

The Desert Highlands serves as a completely different biome in Ferwater, offering a narrower but rather variety of trees and forage. The following lists the trees that spawn here:

  • Cactus, common rarity, spawns more sparsely as you increase in altitude.
  • Purple Cactus, uncommon rarity, tree variant, spawns more frequently up here.
  • Red Cactus, uncommon rarity, tree variant, spawns on only the west side of the Desert Highlands. Not profitable to sell, but a difficult material to find and retrieve initially. Used for filling schematics with a red color scheme.
  • Queen Palm, uncommon rarity, tree variant, spawns only at the Desert Highlands Oasis. Extremely large size and twice as profitable as Sequoia, but much higher in difficulty to transport back to base.

Special and Event Trees

Special types of trees can spawn during special events - typically describing a random weather event. Only Thunderstorm and Meteor event trees are active at this time in Ferwater. If you want to see meteor locations, see the updated Map of Ferwater on the wiki! The trees that fall into this category are listed below:

  • Magma Tree, rare rarity, late-game tree, appears at Meteor impact sites in numbers of 2-5, but can also spawn in the Magma Caves naturally. High health, but also high-return value, sell processed for large profit.
  • Ash Tree, common rarity, late-game tree, appears at Meteor impact sites in numbers of 2-5, but can also spawn in the Magma Caves naturally. Not nearly as profitable as Magma Trees, but can be used as a dark material in builds.
  • Electrified Tree, uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking any type of tree. Can spawn in an Electrified Meteor in numbers of 2-5. High-return value, sell processed for large profit.
  • Electrified Bamboo, uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking Bamboo near Ook Lake. Can spawn in an Electrified Meteor in numbers of 2-5. High-return value, sell processed for decent profit.
  • Eel Kelp, uncommon rarity, tree variant, mid/late-game tree, appears during thunderstorms upon lightning striking Kelp in the ocean. Can spawn in an Electrified Meteor in numbers of 2-5. High-return value, sell processed for decent profit.

Ferwater is unique in that it also has some special variants using Mysterious Mushroom trees. The projectile that they send at the player can also be used to perform the following actions:

  1. By letting a spore projectile hit a piece of refined or forged Ink, it infuses it with a special pink color, becoming ? ? ? (real name is Infused Ink), unique rarity. Required for certain quests.
  2. By letting a spore projectile hit a Meteor Core, it infuses it with a dark aura, becoming an Infused Core, unique rarity. Required for certain quests.
  3. By letting a spore projectile hit any tree (other than Mysterious Mushrooms), it corrupts it with a dark purple color, becoming a Corrupted variant.
  4. By letting a spore projectile hit any stone (other than Fungoidite and Fungiviolet), it corrupts it with a dark purple color, becoming a Corrupted variant.
  5. By letting a spore projectile hit a Tumbleweed, it infuses it with a dark purple color, becoming a Corrupted Tumbleweed.
    • These corrupted variants of materials were originally part of the Halloween update, but have since been made permanent via this method.

Ferwater Lumberwork Summary

For a quick at-a-glance explanation on the rarities and difficulties for obtaining each resource in Oaklands. Note that these are not official in any capacity and are listed to help you estimate which resource you would want to farm or use in your builds!

Rarity Explanation
Common Spawns commonly, low sell value, and typically spawns in easy-to-reach areas.
Uncommon Spawns less frequently, but not particularly rare. Can have decent sell value, or might only spawn in specific areas.
Rare May spawn rarely, can only spawn under certain conditions, has high sell value, or spawns in particularly hard to reach areas.
Unique Is given if a special action is required to obtain it, not necessarily rare or lucrative. Usually for quests.
Difficulty Explanation
Very Easy Extremely common, near to the point of effortlessness to find and farm.
Easy Common, may even be extremely common, but may be harder to farm in large quantities.
Low Medium Common, but it spawns in a specific location that makes it harder to farm in large quantities, or is difficult to transport,
Medium Spawns in a specific location that requires certain tools or is generally a nuisance to farm.
High Medium Spawns in a specific location that requires certain tools and is difficult to transport or is located far away from base.
Difficult Does not have a guaranteed spawn area, requires certain conditions to spawn, requires certain tools. Not possible to farm in large quantities in a short time frame.
Unobtainable Is no longer in the game or its method of obtaining has been removed.
Event Appears for a holiday or special event, such as St. Patricks or Oaklands Anniversary.
Varies For some reason, the difficulty to obtain it can change drastically.

These materials are turned a dark purple and have an extremely reduced sell value. This value depends on what material was corrupted.

Finlay Stone Types

Due to an update with with ore and stone generation, much of the information of ores and stones remain outdated. This list is up-to-date with Oaklands ver 1.79. Ferwater has stone nodes and ore can only be found here, but it also has a lot of crossover with Finlay materials. This is a comprehensive list of stone nodes that spawn in Ferwater:

  • Lightslate, common rarity, early-game stone, found near everywhere in Oaklands.
  • Beigeslate, common rarity, early-game stone, found near everywhere in Oaklands.
  • Chalkyslate, common rarity, early-game stone, in Ferwater Savannah, but can also spawn in Mike’s Mines.
  • Blueslate, common rarity, early-game stone, in Ferwater Savannah (more nodes spawn on the eastern side of Ferwater), but can also spawn in the Ice Mines in the Icelands.
  • Blackstone, common rarity, mid-game stone, in Ferwater Savannah (more nodes spawn on elevated areas on the eastern side of Ferwater), but can also spawn in the Magma Caves.
  • Sandstone, common rarity, early-game stone, spawns on any normal beach. Can also be found in the Desert.
  • Red Sandstone, common rarity, early-game stone, on the red sand beach in Ferwater or Flowering Meadows.
  • Blue, Red, and Brown Clay, common rarity, early/mid-game stone, only spawns underwater near specific areas, typically coastlines.
  • Limestone, common rarity, mid-game stone, spawns in Desert and the Desert Highlands.
  • Sandslate, common rarity, mid-game stone, spawns in the Desert Highlands and the Desert Mines.
  • Terracotta, common rarity, mid-game stone, spawns in the Desert Highlands and the Desert Mines.
  • Fungoidite, common rarity, mid-game stone, spawns in the Mushroom Caves/Uncertainty Cave.

Foraging

**NEED HELP TO KNOW IF THESE ARE ALL THE FORAGEABLES. If you do not see one that should be here, please feel free to add them! Thanks!

**Missing the specific types of Tree Burls, a rare forage item found on (seemingly?) any tree and is specific to that tree (e.g. an oak tree burl). Listed "tree burl", but please add the specific variants as well.

There are several flowers and miscellaneous items that can be picked up from all over Ferwater. Most of these items can be composted and turned into dirt using the Composter. They can also be pressed into jams (for fruits) and dyes (for flowers/other forage items) using the Press Machine and a Jar. Both can be used as decoration items. Jams can be sold at a much higher profit than raw foraged items, and dyes can be used to change wire colors. Most forage items are not worth selling, unless processed (except for a raw Golden Apple, and that should be processed to maximize profit). Most forageables are not worth very much - if you plan to farm with jams/dyes, you should pick a forageable with a high selling rate that is not too annoying to get. As a whole, they should be used as decoration - or for their unique colors.

Ferwater has plentiful foraging items, and some of them can only be found in particular areas. Unlike Finlay, however, Ferwater forage items have slightly higher sell value when selling both raw and processed. The following is a comprehensive list of all the forageable items that can be found in this area.

Crossover Forage

Many forage items are unique to Ferwater, but it still shares a lot of common forage with other areas. To hopefully avoid confusion, these seemingly universal resources (for example, Oak trees, which would not be the first tree you think of when searching for info on Ferwater) are separated. This list contains all forage items that are commonly found in Finlay, but can also be found in Ferwater:

  • Lucky Clovers, common rarity, on grassy ground in the Ferwater Savannah.
  • Blueberries, common rarity, from bushes in the Desert Highland Rivers and the Desert Oasis.
  • Cranberries, common rarity, from bushes in the Desert Highland Rivers and the Desert Oasis.
  • Grapes, common rarity, from bushes in the Desert Highland Rivers and the Desert Oasis.
  • Acorns, common rarity, from Oak trees.
  • Apples, common rarity, from Oak trees.
  • Golden Apples, rare rarity, forage variant, 1/1000 chance to replace an apple, from Oak trees.
  • Pears, common rarity, from Birch trees.
  • Coconuts, common rarity, from Palm trees and across the beach floor.
  • Bananas, common rarity, from King Palm and Queen Palm trees.
  • Beehives, uncommon rarity, from tree leaves whilst using a Saw or picking them by hand.
  • Pink Lotus, common rarity, from Ook Lake or Desert Oasis.
  • Water Lily, common rarity, from Ook Lake or Desert Oasis.

Ground Foraging

Certain forage items in Ferwater only spawn on the ground without any bush, tree, or log to sprout from. Ground forage items that are found in Ferwater are listed here:

  • Sunflowers, common rarity, on grassy ground, in Ferwater Savannah.
  • Tamed Mysterious Mushrooms, uncommon rarity, on stone, behind an explodable wall in the Mushroom Caves/Uncertainty Cave.

Bush Foraging

Certain forage items spawn on bushes and are easier to see. They are typically flowers or fruits that, like ground forageables, can be composted or pressed. Bush forage items that are found in Finlay are listed here:

  • Marigolds, common rarity, on most bushes in Ferwater Savannah.
  • Kiwis, common rarity, uncommonly on some bushes in Ferwater Savannah.

Tree Foraging

Certain forage items spawn on trees and are sometimes visible on the leaves of the tree. If the tree is cut down, the forage items can still be picked up. There is a percent chance that the forage item will rot and disappear if using a regular Axe. However, forage items are guaranteed not to rot if you pick them by hand or use the Living Axe. They are typically seeds or fruits that, like other forageables, can be composted or pressed. Tree forage items that are found in Ferwater are listed here:

  • Lemons, common rarity, on Acacia trees, in Ferwater Savannah.
  • Oranges, common rarity, on Acacia trees, in Ferwater Savannah across Ook Lake (closer to the beaches).
  • Dragonfruits, common rarity, on Acacia trees, in Oke Desert.
  • Green Cactus Flowers, common rarity, on Cactus, in Oke Desert.
  • Purple Cactus Flowers, uncommon rarity, on Purple Cactus, in Oke Desert and the Desert Highlands.
**Need more info on tree burls haven't found one yet. - Snowdin
  • Tree Burls, rare rarity, forage variant, rare chance to spawn on any tree with wood.

Miscellaneous Foraging

Certain forage items have unique spawn conditions. This includes mushrooms that spawn on tree bark and fallen trees/stumps (detritus). Others must have water to spawn on or have strange spawn conditions. Like other forageables, can be composted or pressed. Miscellaneous forage items that are found in Ferwater are listed here:

  • Chantarelle Mushrooms, common rarity, on the ground or on tree bark and on tree detritus (mostly Acacia), in Ferwater Savannah.
  • Chicken Mushrooms, common rarity, on tree bark and on tree detritus, in Ferwater Savannah.
  • Tumbleweed, common rarity, rolling across Oke Desert at random.
  • Corrupted Tumbleweed, uncommon rarity, forage variant, made by infusing a normal Tumbleweed with Mysterious Mushroom spores.

Event or Weather Foraging

Certain forage items have unique spawn conditions. This includes spawning only at night, falling from the sky, or rarer events like Meteors. Seasonal foraging (E.g. ghosts (firefly reskin), St. Patrick's day, moon shards from Halloween, etc.) can also be included here. 

**Star Chances need testing for confirmation. Star chances and weather event calculations are estimated.
  • Stars (Yellow/Green/Red/Blue/Purple), common rarity, forage variant, spawn anywhere on the surface of Ferwater at night.
  • Fireflies (Yellow/Green/Red/Blue/Purple), common rarity, forage variant, spawn anywhere on the surface of Ferwater at night.
    • Yellow, common rarity, has a ~84% or ~8/10 spawn chance.
    • Green, common rarity, has a 10% or 1/10 spawn chance.
    • Red, common rarity, has a 5% or 1/20 spawn chance.
    • Blue, uncommon rarity, has a 0.9% or roughly ~1/100 spawn chance
    • Purple, rare rarity, is the rarest variant. Has a <0.1% or 1/1000 spawn chance.
  • Note that the frequency of star spawns depend upon the weather:
    • During stormy conditions (such as rainy or thunderstorm), star spawning is reduced by about 0.5X.
    • A clear night has a 1/5 chance to be a star shower, where stars spawn 2X more than usual.
  • Meteor Core, uncommon rarity, 100% spawn chance from both a Magmafied Meteor and an Electrified Meteor. Used for special quests.

Trivia

  • Ferwater was the second island to be added to the game, after Finlay Island.
  • Blackstone nodes used to be able to only spawn in the Magma Caves, but have been readded to Ferwater across Ook Lake.
  • There is a truck, supposedly the Sellner Explorer, sunken with its nose buried in the sand in a lake that is to the left of the entrance to Ferwater, near where the Pirate Boat spawns. It appears to have ran through a fence, indicated by the tire marks, and plunged into the lake.
